Minor Expressions

Minor Expressions

Minor Expressions are small supernatural expressions of awakened Attributes.

They are not Powers.
They are not Spells.
They are not combat techniques.

They are minor manifestations of what a high Attribute means in the fiction. Minor Expressions support, color, and enable scenes. They do not replace Powers.

Unlocking Minor Expressions

Minor Expressions are tied to Attributes.

The following Attributes have Minor Expressions:

  • Might
  • Agility
  • Intellect
  • Resolve
  • Influence
  • Wits

Vitality does not have Minor Expressions. To choose a Minor Expression from an Attribute, that Attribute must be at least 4. If an Attribute is lower than 4, its Minor Expressions are not available.

Minor Expression Limit

A character may choose a total number of Minor Expressions equal to their Mastery Rank.

This is a global limit across all Attributes.

Example:

A Mastery Rank 2 character may choose 2 Minor Expressions total. These may both come from the same eligible Attribute, or from different eligible Attributes, as long as each chosen Expression belongs to an Attribute with a value of at least 4.

Attribute Tiers

Minor Expressions grow automatically with the Attribute that unlocks them. Each Minor Expression has five possible tiers:

Current Attribute Value Expression Tier
1-3 Unavailable
4-7 Tier 4
8-11 Tier 8
12-15 Tier 12
16-19 Tier 16
20-40 Tier 20

Use the highest tier whose threshold the Attribute has reached. These are the compressed 1-40 Attribute scale thresholds, converted from the previous wider Attribute scale; do not use obsolete thresholds such as 8/16/24/32 for this progression. Values 21-40 continue to use Tier 20; no sixth Minor Expression tier exists.

Example:

A character with Intellect 11 uses the Tier 8 version of their Intellect Minor Expressions.

A character with Might 4 uses the Tier 4 version of their Might Minor Expressions.

If the Attribute later increases, the Minor Expression improves automatically.

Reroll Point Cost

If the character has a Reroll Point pool, choosing a new Minor Expression costs 1 current Reroll Point.

Removing a Minor Expression refunds 1 Reroll Point, up to the character’s maximum Reroll Points.

If the character does not have enough current Reroll Points to choose a new Minor Expression, they cannot choose it.

If the character has no Reroll Point pool, choosing Minor Expressions has no Reroll Point cost.

Using Minor Expressions

Minor Expressions are used outside direct combat resolution.

They may help a character:

  • create a small opening,
  • color a scene,
  • justify a Skill Check,
  • notice something subtle,
  • influence the tone of a moment,
  • overcome a minor obstacle,
  • or express their awakened nature in the fiction.

Minor Expressions do not automatically replace Skill Checks.

If the outcome is uncertain, opposed, dangerous, or dramatically important, the GM may still call for a normal Skill Check.

A Minor Expression may support the method of a Skill Check, but it does not replace the Skill, the roll, or the normal consequences of failure.

Combat Limitation

Minor Expressions are not combat Powers.

They do not grant attacks, damage, Evade, Armor, healing, movement replacement, Reactions, or Action economy unless a specific rule explicitly says so.

The GM may allow a Minor Expression during a combat scene if it is used for description, positioning, interaction, intimidation, escape setup, or environmental interaction.

However, it should never replace an Active Power, Passive, Active Buff, Reaction, Movement Power, or combat maneuver.
